content:
Returns a list of findings in your organization that match the specified search criteria.
Caution: This endpoint is available for use but is currently in beta. The response structure is subject
to change as we continue to enhance the data model.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the ASSET_INVENTORY.CYBER_ASSET_MANAGEMENT.READ  and
AD.TOGGLE_AD.USE  custom role privileges. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
QUERY PARAMETERS
string ^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+(,[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)*$
Example: extra_properties=prop1,prop2,prop3
Specifies extra findings properties to include in the search results. You can
provide multiple properties as a comma-separated list.
Use the List finding properties endpoint to retrieve a list of valid properties
for this parameter. For example, you might include asset_name ,
solution , and vpr_score  as extra properties.
integer
Default: 0
The starting record to retrieve. If omitted, the default value is 0 .
integer
<= 10000
Default: 1000
The number of records to retrieve. If omitted, the default value is 1000 .
The maximum value is 10000 .
extra_properties
offset
limit
string ^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+:(asc|desc)$
Default: "severity:desc"
Example: sort=severity:desc
The property and direction to sort the results by, in the format
property:direction . For example: finding_name:asc  or
severity:desc
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
required
object
Filter the search results by query. A query consists of search mode and
query text.
Array of objects
A set of finding properties used to filter the search results.
Use the List finding properties endpoint to view available finding properties
that can be used as filters.
